owner_creation.analysis: The thisfile private pointer selects the active ifile-owned filestate; ch_init either borrows an existing state or allocates and attaches a new one.
owner_creation.invariant: Active selection is an alias of an ifile-owned state.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ch_get and navigation functions retain raw state/list/hash pointers across native reads and diagnostics; the thisfile pointer carries no generation or borrow lifetime.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Active-state aliases must not outlive the attached ifile.

callback_targets.analysis: Direct input, display and close/disposal calls can cross module boundaries while the active pointer is live; no callback slot mediates thisfile's lifetime.
callback_targets.invariant: Cross-owner calls require explicit filestate stability.

invalidation.analysis: dispose_ifile_state clears the ifile attachment and thisfile alias before freeing nodes/state; ch_close may retain a nonseekable state for later navigation.
invalidation.invariant: Navigation retention and permanent deletion are different lifetimes.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_init initializes list/hash fields before attaching thisfile; later close/free updates still lack a guarded owner-wide transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: A published active pointer must describe initialized lists.

release_pair.analysis: Disposal clears thisfile when it aliases the retired state, frees nodes/state, and closes only ordinary owned FDs, excluding borrowed stdin.
release_pair.invariant: Borrowed stdin must not be closed by cache disposal.

error_cleanup.analysis: On first-buffer failure thisfile retains its initialized empty sentinel state; ch_get returns -1, and later cleanup can dispose that state without treating it as a buf.
error_cleanup.invariant: A local guard does not certify every cleanup entry.

signals_handoff.analysis: Handler-driven cleanup can cross thisfile aliases during raw mutation; the existing core/input lifetime findings remain open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Source inspection is not maintained finding closure.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.
